known_false_positives.description: Adding `time` -> `TimePicker` is sensible, but please double-check that `$type['name']` is exactly `'time'` for all supported DB drivers/introspection paths (e.g., MySQL `time`, Postgres `time without time zone`, Laravel schema types). If some drivers normalize to `'string'`/`'datetime'`-like names, this mapping won’t trigger. Consider normalizing type names (lowercase, strip modifiers) or handling common variants (e.g., `'time'`, `'timetz'`) to avoid silently generating the wrong component.
